sources.title: The Hallmarks of Aging
sources.limits: Organizational taxonomy, not a demonstrated single causal theory of aging.

sources.title: Hallmarks of Aging: An Expanding Universe
supports: expansion from nine to twelve hallmarks
three-part test for a candidate hallmark
sources.limits: Growth of the list itself is evidence of an unsettled, evolving framework.

sources.title: The hoverfly and the wasp: A critique of the hallmarks of aging as a paradigm
supports: critique of circularity and rhetorical function of the hallmarks framework
sources.limits: A minority, dissenting methodological view within the field, not a rebuttal of the underlying biology.

sources.title: TAME Trial
sources.limits: First-party advocacy-adjacent source for a trial AFAR itself helps fund; cross-checked against independent journalism below.

sources.title: The TAME Trial for Metformin Remains Only Partially Funded
sources.limits: Aggregator/commentary site rather than original reporting.

sources.title: A cheap drug may slow down aging. A study will determine if it works
supports: metformin's unpatentable economics as the funding obstacle
sources.limits: One of two conflicting cost estimates found in research; the chapter states both explicitly rather than resolving the discrepancy.

sources.title: Dr. Nir Barzilai on the TAME Study
supports: $75M TAME budget figure with $40M private donation and $35M AFAR funding
sources.limits: Advocacy-organization blog; conflicts with the NPR figure, flagged explicitly in the chapter.

sources.title: ICD-11 extension code XT9T (Ageing related)
supports: XT9T as an extension/modifier code, not a standalone diagnosis
sources.limits: Classification browser; interpretation of scope drawn from secondary WHO-process reporting below.

sources.title: How 'old age' was withdrawn as a diagnosis from ICD-11
supports: withdrawal of standalone MG2A 'old age' code
sources.limits: Commentary/editorial rather than a WHO primary policy document; used to establish the contested, partial nature of the reclassification.
